author: empire state today
title: Greenberg Traurig receives multiple honors at Turnaround Atlas Awards
text:
Greenberg Traurig, LLP announced on May 13 that its Restructuring & Special Situations Practice received several awards from Global M&A Network at the 18th Annual Turnaround Atlas Awards held on May 12, including being named “USA Restructuring Law Firm of the Year.”
The recognition highlights the firm’s role in significant restructuring and special situations matters. The awards underscore the expertise and commitment of Greenberg Traurig’s professionals in complex legal cases involving financial distress and restructuring.
Shari L. Heyen and Oscar N. Pinkas, co-chairs of the Global Restructuring & Special Situations Practice, said in a joint statement: “We are truly honored to receive this recognition from Global M&A Network, which stands as a testament to the exceptional talent, dedication, and expertise of our restructuring professionals around the globe. This distinction reaffirms our unwavering commitment to delivering sophisticated, client-centered counsel in the most complex and high-stakes restructuring and special situations matters. We have built a practice grounded in trust, precision, and results, and we take great pride in standing alongside our clients during their most critical moments. We remain committed to upholding the highest standards of legal excellence and client service, and we are grateful to our clients and colleagues whose confidence and collaboration makes recognitions such as this truly meaningful.”
In addition to being named law firm of the year for restructuring work in the United States, Greenberg Traurig received other awards at this year’s event. The firm was recognized for “Special Situation M&A Deal of the Year” for its role advising Air Pros Solutions during Chapter 11 bankruptcy sales involving several companies including Buddy’s Heating & Cooling; Southern Air of Thibodaux; Hansen Super Techs; East Coast Mechanical Home Services; Columbia Home Services; Reliance US Holdings; and Any Hour. The deal team included attorneys from multiple offices led by David B. Kurzweil.
The firm also won “Energy & Utilities Restructuring of the Year” for representing Stellex Capital during Rokstad Holdings’ sale of U.S. assets to Stellex Capital itself as well as Canadian assets to Graham Power—a process that involved cross-border insolvency proceedings along with multiple acquisitions.
According to Global M&A Network’s website, The Turnaround Atlas Awards honor value-creating transactions along with outstanding professionals across global insolvency, restructuring, and distressed investing communities.
